name: Overseas Family School
summary: Pasir Ris IB campus with strong mother-tongue pathways — common shortlist for east-side dual-career households comparing SAS/Woodlands vs OFS bus tax.
body: OFS sits in Pasir Ris with IB programmes and a reputation for mother-tongue maintenance beside English-medium learning. Reddit relocation threads often compare OFS + Pasir Ris living against SAS + Woodlands and Stamford + Woodleigh: east-coast/airport convenience vs Johor weekend access vs central-north gravity. Many OFS families still live town-ish and pay the school-bus tax — ask admissions for the bus vendor and sample route times for your postal code before signing a tenancy. Admissions and language placement deserve an early conversation; housing should follow the school shortlist, not the reverse. Verify current campus map and fee stack on the school site. Ask learning-support leads what hours are included in fees versus cash tutoring parents typically add after a curriculum switch — get the distinction in writing.
waitlistNotes: Language programme capacity can gate offers; ask about vacancy by grade and bus catchment before locking housing.
